findings.finding: DATABASE_PRODUCTION_INTENT recovery could inspect or repair the migration ledger and outbox schema while a surviving exact named production migration or resolve runner was still mutating the same database after its original client was interrupted.
findings.required_remediation: At the start of DATABASE_PRODUCTION_INTENT recovery, collision-safely stop and remove both exact label-bound production migration and production resolve runners before the first fresh ledger or catalog observation, then reconcile and retry only through the existing fixed runners.
